name: orbitdocs
description: organizationall tool to manage all your docs in one place

paragraphs: OrbitDocs is a document workspace for individuals, teams, and community organizations. The app provides a focused personal workspace as well as organization spaces where people can discover, join, and manage shared knowledge.

The idea came as a result of community managers like me struggling to manage folder access for their documents and Google Drive does not give much control for member access per folders or other cool features like approval workflow, notifications, and more. OrbitDocs is a solution to that problem.

It initially started as an internal tool for my community(FUTA Techies) so we can manage files across different volunteers teams like events and partnership team files, technical team files amongst others.

whatItDoes.text: OrbitDocs is a document workspace for individuals, teams, and community organizations. The app provides a focused personal workspace as well as organization spaces where people can discover, join, and manage shared knowledge.

requirements.text: Sign in with the account registered under the backend's ADMINEMAIL and open Admin dashboard from the account menu (or go to /admin).
Every account has a unique username and can sign in with email or username.
